dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderate concave curvature along the trailing edge, forming a smooth falcate spline from the posterior base to the rounded apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphological point with a medium pixel radius, lacking acute termination.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin steepness, approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base width to vertical height ratio is approximately 1:1.1, showing a height slightly exceeding the base chord.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: High-radius convex curve forming a prominent, bulbous forehead structure.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Extremely short and robust pixel projection; minimal length extending from the cranial base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Shallow, obtuse interior angle at the transition point between the descending melon and the dorsal rostrum plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive distribution of white, linear striations (parallel and intersecting rake marks) across the visible lateral and dorsal surfaces.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast turquoise-blue base coloration heavily marked by dense, light-colored linear scarring patterns.
